having_IP_Address.label: IP address as host
having_IP_Address.risk: The URL uses a raw IP address instead of a recognized domain name, a tactic to obscure real host identity.
having_IP_Address.safe: The URL uses a standard domain name.

URL_Length.label: URL length
URL_Length.risk: The URL is excessively long (> 75 chars), often used to hide the suspicious domain part.
URL_Length.safe: The URL length is within normal standard bounds (< 54 chars).

Shortining_Service.label: Link shortener
Shortining_Service.risk: Uses a URL shortener to hide the real destination address.
Shortining_Service.safe: Direct domain destination; no URL obfuscation service detected.

having_At_Symbol.label: At symbol in URL
having_At_Symbol.risk: Contains '@' symbol, which causes browsers to ignore preceding text and route to the following host.
having_At_Symbol.safe: No deceptive '@' authentication symbol detected in URL.

double_slash_redirecting.label: Double slash redirect
double_slash_redirecting.risk: Contains '//' deep inside the path, redirecting users to an unexpected host.
double_slash_redirecting.safe: Clean path structure with standard protocol slash position.

Prefix_Suffix.label: Dash in domain name
Prefix_Suffix.risk: Domain name contains a hyphen ('-'), frequently used in brand spoofing (e.g. 'paypal-support.com').
Prefix_Suffix.safe: Domain name does not contain deceptive hyphenated brand prefixes.

having_Sub_Domain.label: Subdomain depth
having_Sub_Domain.risk: Unusually deep subdomain hierarchy (> 2 subdomains), commonly used to mimic complex trusted paths.

HTTPS_token.label: HTTPS in hostname
HTTPS_token.risk: The token 'https' is deceptively added to the domain string (e.g. 'https-login.com').
HTTPS_token.safe: No deceptive protocol token inside the domain name.
